_comment: Fix tickets raised from the audit (ClickUp list SelahCue - Delivery, epic 86ajy5v6k). Keys are the ticket groups used by check_fidelity_audit.py. depends_on lists groups that must merge first.

chrome.title: [Web] Figma fidelity: shared chrome and tokens (Nav, Footer, UiButton, tokens.css, app shell)
chrome.footprint: `implementation/marketing/src/components/Navbar.vue`, `Footer.vue`, `UiButton.vue`; `src/assets/styles/tokens.css` and the global rules in `main.css`; `src/App.vue`; `src/router/scroll.ts`; their tests under `tests/`.
chrome.parallel: Runs in parallel with the shared-components ticket. All six area tickets wait for this one to merge before they finish (they may start earlier and rebase).

components.title: [Web] Figma fidelity: shared components (UiBadge, FormField, FaqAccordion, PricingCard, ConfirmDialog)
components.parallel: Runs in parallel with the chrome ticket (different files). All area tickets wait for it.

home.title: [Web] Figma fidelity: Home page
home.footprint: `implementation/marketing/src/views/HomeView.vue`, `src/components/ConsoleMockup.vue`, `OutputManagerMockup.vue`, `TestimonialCard.vue`, `FeatureCard.vue`, `ReliabilityPillar.vue` (the Features page must not edit the two mockups: it builds its own panels), `tests/`.
home.parallel: Runs in parallel with the other area tickets once the chrome and components tickets have merged.

core.title: [Web] Figma fidelity: Pricing, Features, Download and About
core.footprint: `implementation/marketing/src/views/PricingView.vue`, `FeaturesView.vue`, `DownloadView.vue`, `AboutView.vue`; new page-local components if needed (do NOT edit ConsoleMockup or OutputManagerMockup: the Home ticket owns them); `tests/` including `downloadView.test.ts`.
core.parallel: Runs in parallel with the other area tickets once the chrome and components tickets have merged.

secondary.title: [Web] Figma fidelity: Contact, Support, Docs, Changelog, Blog, Careers, Privacy, Terms and Affiliates
secondary.parallel: Runs in parallel with the other area tickets once the chrome and components tickets have merged.

auth.title: [Web] Figma fidelity: Sign in, Verify (V1-V6) and Reset (R1-R7)
auth.parallel: Runs in parallel with the other area tickets once the chrome and components tickets have merged.

account.title: [Web] Figma fidelity: Account page and Manage Devices (D1-D6)
account.footprint: `implementation/marketing/src/views/AccountView.vue`, a new `src/views/AccountDevicesView.vue`, the new `/account/devices` route in `src/router/index.ts`, `src/lib/api/account.ts` (device operations once the API exists), `tests/`, `scripts/auth_pages_headless.py` scenarios for the new states.
account.parallel: Runs in parallel with the other area tickets once the chrome and components tickets have merged. Starts after the Sign Out bug ticket lands (same file).

decisions.title: [Design] Decisions needed from the Figma audit: claims the repo does not back (class C) and gaps in the designs (class D)

devices-api.title: [Backend] Customer-session GraphQL for Manage Devices: list devices, last seen, limit and used, deactivate, viewer role

sign-out-bug.title: [Web] Account page "Sign Out" button never signs out: it only navigates to /signin

selftest-ci.title: [CI] Run the visual-parity self-test and the audit checker's self-test in make ci and CI (no browser, about 1 second)
